subject: Coordinating joint customer announcement with Zephyr Health — embargo & quotes
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Riley Gomez <riley@zephyrpr.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Joint announcement timing & quote request

Hi Jordan + Laura,

Hope you’re both well — excited to share that Zephyr Health is planning a product announcement the week of Sep 6 and we’d love Redwood on the press release as an integration partner. Riley (cc’d) is our PR lead and will coordinate embargo and distribution.

High-level asks from our side:
- Can you confirm a 1–2 sentence customer quote from Redwood by Tue 8/24?
- We’d like to set an embargo for 8:00 AM ET on Wed 9/2 (choose if that works for Redwood).
- We’ll provide logo files and a headshot for our sponsor (Aaron Cho).

We’re flexible on quote wording — speaking to performance gains and predictable inference costs would be ideal.

Attachments: zephyr_logo_rgb.png (logo, 120KB)

Thanks — Maya
Maya Patel
Head of Partnerships, Zephyr Health
maya@zephyrhealth.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint announcement timing & quote request

Thanks Maya — excited to partner on this. Quick notes and proposed plan:

1) Quote: we can provide a short quote focused on performance and deployment flexibility. Draft below — please feel free to tweak: 

"Working with Zephyr Health, we reduced inference latency and achieved more predictable per-request costs, enabling faster rollout of clinical features to providers."

Laura, can you take the lead on tightening that to something ~25 words and send back by Mon 8/24 EOD so Maya has time to include it in copy?

2) Embargo: 9/2 8:00 AM ET works on our end but we need legal clearance. Marissa — can you confirm legal sign-off by 8/27? If not, propose contingency of 9/9.

3) Assets & approvals: Karthik — please prepare a single-slide customer blurb (1–2 bullets + stat) and confirm if we can share a short performance chart. Also confirm whether we need a signed testimonial release or standard customer PR agreement.

Riley — Jordan here; would love a quick call next week (15–20m) to align distribution and embargo list. I’m available Tue/Wed afternoons PT.

Attaching an internal draft of the joint PR (very rough): draft_joint_pr_v1.docx [Attachment stub].

—
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Maya Patel <maya@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 13:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Joint announcement timing & quote request

Jordan — thanks, forwarding a tightened quote below. Maya — feel free to use verbatim or tweak for flow.

"Zephyr Health’s integration with Redwood Inference delivered consistently low latency at scale while cutting inference cost per request — enabling Zephyr to roll new clinical workflows to customers faster."

Marissa — tagging you for legal/PR clearance. Any red flags on the wording? If we need a release form, I can push to the customer to sign this week.

Attachment: draft_joint_pr_v1.docx (v1 with inline edits, 45KB)

Laura Bennett
Head of Communications, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Maya Patel <maya@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Riley Gomez <riley@zephyrpr.com>, Dr. Aaron Cho <aaron.cho@zephyrhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Joint announcement timing & quote request

Thanks Laura — that wording looks great and concise. A few logistical items: 

- Embargo: we’ll keep 9/2 8:00 AM ET. Our PR team needs final quotes and high-res logos/headshot by Fri 8/28 COB to hit internal review.
- Aaron has approved the inclusion and will send his headshot (attaching now).
- Riley will send the final embargo list and distribution plan; Jordan, can you confirm whether Redwood is ok being on the headline or prefer to be second-paragraph partner mention?

Attachments: aaron_headshot.jpg (150KB), zephyr_logo_rgb.png (120KB)

Maya

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@zephyrhealth.com>, Riley Gomez <riley@zephyrpr.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint announcement timing & quote request

All — final confirmations below: 

1) Quote: Laura’s line (sent 8/24) is approved by Redwood leadership. You have permission to use it verbatim.

2) Headline placement: Redwood prefers partner-mention in paragraph two (we’re good with headline if Zephyr insists, but prefer second paragraph).

3) Legal & release: Marissa confirms we’ll use a standard customer PR release; I’m sending DocuSign to Zephyr’s legal contact after this thread. Marissa — please reply with the one-paragraph release statement we need signed.

4) Assets: Received Aaron’s headshot and logo — thanks. Karthik will deliver a single-slide blurb and one performance chart by 9/1 EOD.

5) Embargo: we’re aligned for 9/2 8:00 AM ET. Jordan available for a 20m prep call Wed 9/1 11:00 AM ET if useful.

Attachments: redwood_quote_final.txt (inline), draft_joint_pr_v2.docx [will share after legal OK]

—
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
